title: Pro-Pinball: The Web
overview:
Experience the true feel, speed, action and excitement of your very own pinball table. With a variety of viewpoints, rock soundtrack, in-game speech, dot-matrix display, hidden subgames, and up to six chrome balls whizzing around. You will never want to play any other pinball games ever again.

Pro-Pinball - The Web, the total pinball experience.
